Definition: Does the government maintain a digital civil register?
Comments: Civil Registry Authority exists with electronic data; Intilaqa project matching electronic and paper records across 257 offices, 97% families covered.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed: the Civil Registry Authority maintains a nationwide electronic database (257 offices, 97% of Libyan families matched as of Sept 2024) used as the basis for issuing National ID Numbers to all citizens. Recent 2026 reports of registry fraud reflect data-integrity problems, not deployment status. Partially deployed is well supported; no change.

Definition: Is the register integrated with the national ID system?
Comments: National ID Number system planned based on civil registry records.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Law No. 8 of 2014 requires National ID Numbers to be issued at birth directly from Civil Registry data, and Libya Herald (Sept 2024) confirms this is established practice: all Libyan nationals are issued a unique National ID Number by the Civil Registry Authority. This is a mature, universal technical linkage rather than a system still 'under development' as the 2013/2014 original source suggested; revised upward to Fully integrated nationwide.

Definition: What proportion of the electorate does the register cover?
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Total registered voters have stood at ~2.87 million since the 2021 registration drive (confirmed unchanged by Middle East Monitor, Oct 2022) against an estimated voting-age population of roughly 4.3-4.5 million (c.63-65% of Libya's ~7m population, based on International IDEA trend data). This gives approximately 62-65% coverage — the 50-69% band, not 70-89%. No comprehensive national registration drive has occurred since 2021, only partial, phased municipal-election registrations; revised down.

revision_notes: The cited 2010 source predates the 2011 revolution and no longer reflects reality. Definition: Does the government maintain a digital land register?
Comments: Digital land administration system implemented in 7 of 45 departments with automated workflow; separate cadastral.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The 2010 source describing a 'fully automated workflow across 45 departments' predates the 2011 revolution, after which the Real Estate Registration Authority was suspended entirely for a decade. It was only 'partially reactivated' in 2022 (Decision 578/2022) and issued its first-ever electronic certificate in April 2025. Digitisation is only now beginning; revised down from Partially deployed to Under development.
